notes.title: OpenXR Version (Beta) has been released
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of the OpenXR version (Beta) of VR MEDIA VIEWER. While previous versions managed VR devices using different VR Plugin Frameworks for each device, this version adopts OpenXR, a unified framework for VR. If you experience any issues with versions 1.2.7 or earlier, please try this version.

Please note that for the OpenXR version, since you must manually "activate the OpenXR runtime differently for each device" as described later, we currently have no plans to make it a major version. Please understand that this is only a trial (Beta) version to use when versions 1.2.7 and below are not working properly.

[h3]Please make sure to activate the OpenXR runtime before use[/h3]

Unlike versions 1.2.7 and earlier, this OpenXR version will not launch unless you perform the "Activate OpenXR Runtime" operation in device management applications such as SteamVR (for HTC VIVE, Valve Index, Pico, etc.), Meta Quest Link (for Oculus Quest, Meta Quest), or OpenXR Tools for Windows Mixed Reality (for WindowsMR). Below are examples of how to activate the runtime in these three device management applications. For other devices, please refer to your device's manual, which should contain information about OpenXR, and follow the instructions provided there.

[b]SteamVR[/b]

	[SteamVR] > [Click upper left] > [Settings] > [OpenXR] > [SET STEAMVR AS OPENXR RUNTIME]
	
[b]Meta Quest Link[/b]
	
	[Meta Quest Link]> [Settings] > [General] > [OpenXR Runtime] > [Set Meta Quest Link as active]
	
[b]WindowsMR[/b]

	[Instal "OpenXR Developer Tools for Windows Mixed Reality" from official] > [Mixed Reality] > [Installation status] > [Set as active runtime]
	
[h3]How to Install OpenXR Version[/h3]

[Steam client software] > [Library] > [VR MEDIA VIEWER (right click)] > [Properties] > [Beta] > [Select the beta... (openxr - OpenXR version (Beta))] > Will start downloading (If it doesn't update, try restarting your Steam client)

If you want to revert to the major version, change [Select the beta... (openxr - OpenXR version (Beta))] to [Select the beta... (None)] and the download of the latest version will start (If it doesn't update, try restarting your Steam client)

tags.feature: We are pleased to announce the release of the OpenXR version (Beta) of VR MEDIA VIEWER.

notes.title: Update version 1.2.6
notes.content:
Thank you for using VR MEDIA VIEWER!!
We updated following contents today.

[h1]Version 1.2.6[/h1]

Fix / Bug fix :
- When "Include folder shortcuts" is enabled, there may be a waiting time of several seconds to several tens of seconds (for network drives) when accessing a hierarchy that contains shortcuts to disconnected drives. A tooltip related to this issue has been added.
- The default value for "Settings >> Include folder shortcuts" has been changed to OFF.
- Adjusted the acceleration for the controller to wake up from hidden state.
- Fixed a bug where the file browser and media screen would be duplicated when a headset was removed and left idle for a while during the application launch on certain devices, and then the headset was reattached.

Please enjoy!! Thanks!!

[h1]About version 1.2.0[/h1]

In this update (version 1.2.0), we have greatly modified the input system script to prepare for the addition of some functions and support for new devices in the future. We have confirmed that it works properly on a supported VR device, but if you experience a malfunction when playing the application, we would appreciate it if you could reply to this thread. (It would also be helpful to report normal operation.)

In case version 1.2.0 does not work properly, we will reserve the previous version 1.1.9 on the server. If you want to use version 1.1.9, please follow the steps below.

[Steam client software] > [Library] > [VR MEDIA VIEWER (right click)] > [Properties] > [Beta] > [Select the beta... (1.1.9 - Previous version)] > Version 1.1.9 will start downloading

If you want to revert to the latest version, change [Select the beta... (1.1.9 - Previous version)] to [Select the beta... (None)] and the download of the latest version will start.

notes.title: Update version 1.1.8
notes.content:
Thank you for using VR MEDIA VIEWER!!
We updated following contents today.

[h1]Version 1.1.8[/h1]

Function addition / Specification change / Fix / Bug fix :
- Support for images and animations of WebP format. (Waiting time occurs when loading an animation file with a large data size)
- Supports transparency of 2D screen images and videos. (ON / OFF can be set on the Settings)
- The loading status is now displayed in % when loading GIF animations.
- Changed the specification so that if the frame rate of GIF and WebP animation is within 0.01 seconds, it will be 0.1 seconds. (Same specifications as a general web browser)
- Supports moire reduction in image formats other than JPG and PNG.
- Fixed the aspect ratio of the screen when applying the screen curve.
- Fixed memory management.
- Fixed a bug where the left controller model was incorrect when using Oculus.
- Fixed a bug where the screen display would be strange when trying to grab the same screen with the left and right pointers at the same time.

Please enjoy!! Thanks!!

Function addition :
- Added ".vr.jpg" (Google VR180 format*) to supported images.
- Added support for thumbnail display of ".vr.jpg" and ".mpo" files

* VR180 format (Google Cardboard Camera VR Photo Format) is a format for storing stereoscopic photos, panorama photos, and audio (not supported on VRMV) for playback on VR devices. Currently, "Lenovo Mirage Camera", "YI Horizon VR180 Camera" and "Z Cam K1 Pro" have been announced as official cameras. Google VR180: https://arvr.google.com/vr180/

Please enjoy!! Thanks!!
